wineGlass.evidenceText: The public Wine By The Glass / Red Wine section is explicitly labelled Glass (15cl) and lists Mendoza Malbec Terrazas de los Andes $100, Bourgogne Pinot Noir Château de Dracy $150, Saint-Estèphe Château Les Ormes de Pez $200, and Barolo Massolino $240.
